name: Product Hunt
notes: Launches are best on Tuesdays/Wednesdays at 00:01 PST. Account must have 5+ days of activity before posting. Upvote window is 24 hours.

name: G2
notes: B2B review platform. Requires business email and company verification. Listings typically go live within 2-3 weeks. High-authority backlink.

name: Capterra
notes: Requires business email. Listing review typically takes 5-7 business days. Free listing available; paid placement also exists.

name: AlternativeTo
notes: Free listing. Categories and alternatives can be added post-submission. Good for organic discovery.

name: BetaList
notes: Pre-launch and early-stage focus. Free submission goes into a queue (2-4 weeks). Paid option ($129) skips the queue. Good for early email signups.

name: Indie Hackers
notes: Community-driven. Requires founder verification. Best for bootstrapped or revenue-transparent products. Add your MRR if you have it.

name: SaaSHub
notes: Often auto-indexes from public data. Manual submission ensures faster and more accurate indexing. Good evergreen discovery.

name: Peerlist
notes: Developer-focused community. Strong for dev tools, APIs, and B2D (business-to-developer) products. Growing fast in 2024-2025.

name: Uneed
notes: Daily curated launches with upvoting. Free to submit. Best launch days Monday through Wednesday. Simple form.

name: Startup Stash
notes: Curated resource directory. Free listing. Reviewer approval typically takes 1-2 weeks. Strong SEO signal for bootstrapped tools.
